visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman in a floral sundress standing in a room with a grand piano. She waves enthusiastically at the camera, her facial expression wide and joyful. (2) She points toward the top of the frame, and the camera pans upward to reveal a black studio ceiling equipped with heavy lighting grids and electrical cords, indicating the room is a set. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a Numark record player. A vinyl record is spinning, featuring a cartoon cat wearing a powdered wig on the center label. (4) The woman points at various shelves filled with books and music scores. She touches a blue score on a wall-mounted shelf. (5) She stands next to a large framed portrait of the same cartoon cat in a wig, smiling and hugging the frame affectionately. (6) In a wider shot, she demonstrates a manual curtain mechanism by crawling behind a sofa and pulling a string, looking humorously strained. (7) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the woman playing piano on a stage, performing with a string ensemble, and dressed in various costumes, ending with her making heart gestures and waving goodbye.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-arousal female voice speaking at a rapid pace, accompanied by an upbeat classical piano track. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect transitions into the second phase, where the speaker's pitch rises as she points out the studio ceiling. (3) A muffled vinyl static sound is heard briefly as the turntable is shown, followed by the BGM swelling in volume. (4) Distinct 'ding' and 'pop' comedic sound effects punctuate each point of her list, maintaining a lighthearted and energetic rhythm. (5) The music shifts slightly to a more melodic, sentimental tone when she hugs the cat portrait, accompanied by a magical 'sparkle' SFX. (6) Sounds of fabric rustling and exaggerated breathing indicate physical effort as she pulls the manual curtains, followed by a cartoon-style impact sound. (7) The finale features a full orchestral BGM layer over a collage of performance clips, ending with a cheerful, high-pitched verbal sign-off and a final musical stinger.
